description: Get the verbatim text of a Texas Administrative Code rule (agency regulation, NOT a statute) by citation, with subsection structure intact. "16 TAC 26.420(f)(3)(B)" is title 16 (Public Utility Commission), rule 26.420, subsection (f)(3)(B); pass it as citation, or as title "16" + rule "26.420" (+ optional subsection). Returns the rule heading, its place in the Code, the text of the requested subsection and everything under it, and the TexReg amendment history. A rule that does not exist answers found:false. Use for "text of 16 TAC 26.420", "what does 22 TAC 153.1 say", or any "Texas Administrative Code" / "TAC" / "Tex. Admin. Code" ask.

chapter.description: Chapter, only needed when rule is given without it (e.g. rule "420", chapter "26").

citation.description: Full citation, e.g. "16 TAC 26.420(f)(3)(B)" or "22 Tex. Admin. Code 153.1". Replaces title/rule/subsection.

rule.description: Rule as cited, chapter.rule, e.g. "26.420". The chapter is the part before the dot.

subsection.description: Optional subsection path, e.g. "(f)(3)(B)". Returns just that subsection and its clauses.

title.description: TAC title number, e.g. "16" (Economic Regulation), "22" (Examining Boards), "30" (Environmental Quality).

name: tx_admin_rule
title: Tx Admin Rule
